_comment: Curated FAMILY index for tooling (read by resolve_ec_screen.py for the sibling/golden-exemplar hint). NOT a full mirror of ec_screen_registry.md - it covers the IUD families (OV / TV / PC) plus their golden exemplars and representative members. Run-only patterns (N1/N2/N3/RUN-verify) live in the markdown's 'Screen TYPES' section. KEEP IN SYNC: when a new family or a new golden exemplar appears, update this file and the markdown's 'Screen families & golden exemplars' table together.

schema.class_type: DB class_cnfg.CLASS_TYPE that the resolver can match on (OBJECT / TABLE / null=either)
schema.discriminator: what the LIVE scan must show to confirm this family (the resolver is DB-only, so it offers candidates; the scan disambiguates)
schema.golden_exemplar: the canonical screen to CLONE - held to a higher bar
schema.page_object: T3 page object of the golden exemplar
schema.t2: shared T2 resource the family delegates to

families.label: OV - Manage-Object (date-effective)
families.discriminator: navigator is a date / plain manage-object with NO mandatory nav dropdown; grid id manage_object_nav_nav:form:T_data
families.delete: End Date = Start Date (true delete from OV_* view)

families.label: OV - custom-URL (no navigator GO; reload via toolbar Refresh)
families.discriminator: no navigator GO button; grid nav:form:T_data (or manageObject:form:T_data); Save And Refresh List falls back to toolbar Refresh

families.label: OV-GM - groupmodel (PU / PU-Area cascade)
families.discriminator: mandatory PU (-> Area) cascade nav dropdown(s) + GO; insert sets the Op-parent dd = the nav value; grid manageObject:form:T_data; grid redraws lazily
families.delete: End Date = Start Date (+ one extra Apply Navigator)

families.label: OV-GM - Business-Unit-gated
families.discriminator: mandatory Business Unit nav dropdown (nav:form:G:0:R:1:C:1:dd) + GO; the insert form's parent dd (Business Unit Name / Contract / Pipeline / Transport System) must equal the nav scope or the row never lists; grid manageObject:form:T_data; lazy redraw -> T3 Row Should Exist must wait (R17)

families.label: OV-GM + EC-object popup picker
families.discriminator: BU-gated, plus a reference chosen via an EC object POPUP (Pick From EC Object Popup) rather than a dropdown; the BU also gates the popup list

families.label: TV - Table class (inline-editable grid, physical delete)
families.discriminator: no navigator; paginated inline grid; cells {grid}:form:T:{row}:C{col}_in; mandatory cells render yellow; commit with real keystrokes + Tab (not fill())

families.label: PC - parent-child setup (count-delta DB oracle)
families.discriminator: navigator picks a PARENT (class + object) + GO; the parent's items show in an inline grid; insert/delete toolbar entries are named for the item

families.label: EVENT-LOG - gated inline event grid (DATA/DAY class)
families.discriminator: DATA/DAY class shown as a gated inline grid; cascade nav (Date + PU/Area/Facility Class 1) + GO before the grid loads; ADD event rows; no object code (identify by a unique free-text marker cell); physical delete

parked_or_excluded.reason: groupmodel not enabled - inserts persist but the grid never lists them
operational groupmodel not enabled in this environment
Op PU lives in the groupmodel layer; insert leaves NULL op-PU = invisible in every PU filter
